meta.name: gemini
meta.description: Google Gemini chat models via inference.sh CLI. Models: Gemini 4 Argon (flagship), Gemini 3.8 Flash (most capable Flash), Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite (fastest, lowest cost). 1M token context, thinking levels, vision, file input, tool use, structured output. Runs on Vertex AI. Use for: coding, autonomous agents, long documents, finance, law, science, high-throughput pipelines, image understanding, chat. Triggers: gemini, google gemini, gemini api, gemini 4, gemini 4 argon, argon, gemini flash, gemini 3.8 flash, gemini flash lite, gemini 3.5 flash-lite, vertex ai, google llm, google ai model, gemini chat
